title: Read-and-articulate runbook (specialized runbook; full four-regime descent)
description: Restriction of runbook to the six-step file-ingestion pattern walking the full four-regime descent: reading-file (aperiodic-articulating) → decoding (aperiodic-articulating) → predicating (transfinite-predicating) → positing (scott-continuous-positing) → settling (finite-settling) → tracking-cell. The runbook record itself is finite-settlement-algebra; its steps traverse all four regimes — the canonical 'heterogeneous input becomes SPO rows' pipeline.
